domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record retrieved. Attempts blocked or empty: galalite.com/about-us returned HTTP 403; thecompanycheck.com and zaubacorp.com returned HTTP 403; tofler.in returned HTTP 404; eximpedia.app and volza.com returned HTTP 403; DuckDuckGo search backend was down ("Connection refused") for both queries, so no GeM/CPPP tender or GST-turnover page could be located. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP contract awards and annual-report India-vs-export splits: null (not public in sources reachable here).
note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated Indian customs export records with B/L numbers, destination countries and HS codes exist for 2026-02-09, 2026-02-13 and 2026-02-23, shipping from Nhava Sheva Sea and Sahar Air Cargo to UAE, Ecuador and Poland, with repeat buyers in Poland (Semcon, 68 shipments), Kuwait (KNCC, 41), Russia (Art Sound Cinema, 30) and Fiji (Damodar Cinemas, 27). HS observed on the export rows is 90106000 (projection screens) and 39219099 (PVC sheetings), which matches the declared HS 901060 — no correction needed. Note the declared industry label 'IT и электроника' is imprecise: the actual trade is cinema projection screens and audio-visual equipment (HS 9010), plus PVC sheetings; the company also appears as an importer of projection-screen components from GBS Electronic (Hong Kong/China) and Semcon (Poland), i.e. it is a manufacturer_trader profile rather than a pure trader. Domestic Indian supply activity could not be verified from any reachable public source — this is a gap in evidence, not a finding of absence; the company clearly has an operating Mumbai factory address and multi-year export flow, so domestic sales are plausible but unproven here. No sanctions/court/ownership issues were examined (out of scope for this role).
